title: bench results real LoCoMo combined arm accuracy
summary: Real LoCoMo bench (conv-26, 50 probes, 2026-06-18): combined=36%, distill=34%, search=12%, our-way=10%, cold=0%. Distill arm (185 atomic facts from 19 sessions) is 3x better than raw session-chunk search. Category breakdown: cat2 combined=50%, cat1 combined=26%, cat3 combined=14%. Competitor bars for reference: Mem0 ~84%, Zep ~75% on LoCoMo (different setup). Two bugs fixed in this session: (1) cosine floor bug (lib/embed.js best=0, merged fix-distill-search-floor); (2) pendingDup invisibility — search arm now routes through embedded daemon (fresh overlay, no pendingDup). Main remaining accuracy gap vs competitors: raw session notes are too long/diffuse for good retrieval; distill arm addresses this but still trails competitor bars.
